findings.summary: PiiSession._learn_money omits Decimal in isinstance check, failing to learn or redact canonical compensation values
findings.expected: Per Decision G3 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-piece-g-governance-design.md:12) and Decision C2 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-piece-c-data-protection-design.md:26), when tokenize_compensation is enabled, compensation fields must be tokenised. Since canonical models store compensation as Decimal (e.g. CanonicalEmployee.salary), Decimal amounts must be learned and redacted.
findings.actual: _learn_money checks isinstance(value, (int, float, str)) which evaluates to False for Decimal values, silently ignoring them and allowing plaintext compensation numbers to reach LLM prompts without tokenisation.
findings.repro: s = PiiSession(tokenize_compensation=True); s.learn({'salary': Decimal('45000.00')}); assert s.find_pii('salary 45000.00') == ['COMPENSATION']
findings.resolution: Fixed: PiiSession._learn_money accepts Decimal; nested Decimal tool output is tokenised; tests/unit/test_gaps_fixes.py.
